newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Copper may look to $2,500 to spur buying.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Copper may look to $2,500 to spur buying.

text.p: 3 MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
---------------VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - June 10- -----------
Copper could face another sideways trading day on Tuesday after a dull opening to the week which was leavened only by a fall in stocks, analysts said.
With the 10-day moving average falling close to market levels, a push above it at $2,500 would prompt technical buying, they said.
COPPER -
Prices seem range-bound after a quiet start to the week aided by a fall in London Metal Exchange (LME) warehouse stocks and a weaker dollar, analysts said.
However the 10-day moving average poised at $2,500 could act as a spur to buying and help lift the market over its next psychological hurdle.
"It would not be surprising to see the market attempting to get above this level so as to spur technical buying," said Brandeis (Brokers) Ltd in its market commentary.
A breach of the resistance -- precisely at $2,502 -- could signal a move to $2,510 which it turn makes $2,531 accessible, analyst said.
On the downside, there is a block of support from $2,484 down to $2,445.
At 0745, copper was indicated at $2,500/$2,505, about $7.00 above Monday's late London level.
ALUMINIUM -
A test of fanline resistance at $1,617 was possible after aluminium traded in a $19 range on Monday, analysts said.
A rally to $1,627 and possibly higher could follow if the resistance was taken out.
Initial resistance came in at $1,611 and some concern must be noted at Monday's failure to close above the $1,608 resistance level, analysts said.
But guarding the downside is support at $1,600 that remains intact.
"With the RSI now rising, the market looks poised to move higher in the short term," said Brandeis (Brokers) Ltd in its daily commentary.
